vertebrae.cache.local_store
===========================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.cache.local_store

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Local filesystem artifact store.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.cache.local_store.LocalArtifactStore


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: LocalArtifactStore(root = '.vertebrae_cache')

   Store dense/sparse arrays and JSON metadata under a local directory.

   :param root: Root cache directory.


   .. py:method:: config()

      Return a serializable config for reconstructing this store.



   .. py:method:: exists(key)

      Return whether an embedding artifact exists for `key`.

      :param key: Artifact key.

      :returns: Whether a dense `.npy` or sparse `.npz` embedding file exists.



   .. py:method:: put_array(key, arr)

      Store a dense or sparse embedding matrix.

      :param key: Artifact key.
      :param arr: Dense array-like object or scipy sparse matrix.

      :returns: Filesystem path to the saved artifact.



   .. py:method:: put_array_batches(key, batches, n_samples, require_complete = True)

      Store embeddings from deterministic batches.

      :param key: Artifact key.
      :param batches: Iterable of `(indices, embeddings)` batch pairs.
      :param n_samples: Total number of rows in the full embedding artifact.
      :param require_complete: Whether every row must be written exactly once.

      :returns: Filesystem path to the saved artifact.

      :raises ValueError: If batches contain duplicate indices, invalid shapes, or
          incomplete coverage when `require_complete` is true.



   .. py:method:: get_array(key)

      Load a dense or sparse embedding matrix.

      :param key: Artifact key.

      :returns: Dense NumPy array or scipy sparse matrix.



   .. py:method:: put_labels(key, labels)

      Store labels as a JSON artifact.

      :param key: Artifact key.
      :param labels: One-dimensional labels.

      :returns: Filesystem path to the saved labels file.



   .. py:method:: get_labels(key)

      Load labels from a JSON artifact.

      :param key: Artifact key.

      :returns: One-dimensional label array.



   .. py:method:: put_json(key, obj)

      Store JSON metadata for an artifact key.

      :param key: Artifact key.
      :param obj: JSON-serializable metadata.

      :returns: Filesystem path to the saved metadata file.



   .. py:method:: get_json(key)

      Load JSON metadata for an artifact key.

      :param key: Artifact key.

      :returns: Metadata dictionary.
